answer_2.quote: The performance for the text domain is computed by the average results on TruthfulQA (Acc) and AlpacaEval (Win Rate) datasets; the performance for the code domain is Pass@1 of HumanEval; and the performance for the math domain is the average result of GSM8K (Pass@1), MATH (Pass@1), SAT-Math (Acc), and AQuA-RAT (Acc) datasets.

answer_3.quote: We use reward model ArmoRM and GPT-4o to score and select response.
